__comment: DelightfulCompat MILK-BUCKET FALLBACK (the canonical example of conditional-loading requested in the spec). Farmer's Delight's 'cake_from_milk_bottle' requires farmersdelight:milk_bottle. If a pack lacks the mod/item that provides a milk bottle, this recipe loads instead and lets you craft a cake from plain milk buckets. The neoforge:not + neoforge:item_exists condition means it ONLY loads when farmersdelight:milk_bottle is absent, so it never conflicts when the bottle exists. Copy this file as a template for other 'needs milk bottle' recipes in your pack.
